agentGuide: Base path /v2. Me: GET /users/me; users of the account: GET /users?page_size=30. Meetings: GET /users/me/meetings?type=upcoming (id, topic, start_time, join_url); one: GET /meetings/<id>; create: POST /users/me/meetings {"topic": "...", "type": 2, "start_time": "2026-10-02T10:00:00", "timezone": "Europe/Paris", "duration": 30, "settings": {"waiting_room": true}} (type 1 = instant, 2 = scheduled, 8 = recurring); update: PATCH /meetings/<id>; cancel: DELETE /meetings/<id>. Past meetings: GET /past_meetings/<id>/participants; recordings: GET /users/me/recordings?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD (download_url needs the token as ?access_token=, which you do not have: give the play_url). Reports: GET /report/users/me/meetings?from=&to=. The app's scopes bound what works (meeting:read:admin, meeting:write:admin…). The token is set by Allkin.
